title: Provenance
description: Where an entity came from. (source, content_hash) is the import dedupe key and unique from schema 0.3.

source_ref.description: Specific origin: file path, statement id, or external record id.

content_hash.description: Stable hash of the identifying source fields, hex-encoded.

batch_id.description: The import run that wrote the row. Schema 0.3.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 of the whole source file, lowercase hex. Schema 0.3.

reader.description: The parser and its version, e.g. 'finance.csv.sparebank1/2'. Schema 0.3.
